port.description: The port of the http server

directory.description: The directory containing the files served by the http server

clientScriptRoute.description: Route from which the script responsible for reloading the page will be served from

websocketRoute.description: The route from which the client script will be notified of reload events

pingIntervalMs.description: The interval between ping messages sent by the server to the client

watcher.description: The configuration for the filesystem watcher

directories.description: Directories that will be watched (recursively) for changes

pollIntervalMs.description: The time in milliseconds that elapses between each time the fs events are polled (and the handlers triggered)

handlers.description: The handlers for the file's changes

command.description:
The command that will be executed when this handler is triggered. Supports golang template variable expansion for the following variables:
- {{.FileBase}} The basename of the file that triggered the handler
- {{.FileAbs}} The absolute path of the file that triggered the handler
- {{.FileDir}} The absolute directory of the file that triggered the handler

extensions.description: A list of file extensions that will trigger this handler

files.description: A list of files (absolute path) that will trigger this handler

regex.description: All filenames that will match this regex will trigger this handler

printStdOut.description: Wether stdout of the command of this handler should be echoed to stdout

printStdErr.description: Wether stderr of the command of this handler should be echoed to stderr
